rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Direxion Daily Small Cap Bull 3X
positions.catalyst: Broad risk-on rotation to open August: crude oil down ~6% on renewed US-Iran talks/easing tensions, a cooler Treasury tape (yields lower), and decisively strong breadth with small-caps and blue-chip industrials leading the 'catch-up' trade. IWM (Russell 2000) +1.34% intraday and outrunning a muted mega-cap tech tape. This is a multi-factor macro tailwind (lower oil + lower rates + broad participation), not a single binary event, so the leadership group has room to extend into the next 24h.
positions.driver: LONG TNA (3x Russell 2000), 100% capital. Small-caps are the day's clear leadership and are the most rate-/oil-sensitive cohort — exactly the group that benefits most from a 6% oil drop and a cooler rates read, giving a genuine fresh multi-factor catalyst that justifies 3x leverage. Chose TNA over SPXL (3x S&P, +0.57% — broader but far less momentum; S&P dragged by muted tech) because the leadership and the macro sensitivity both point to small caps. Entry 70.69 is only ~4% up on the day (IWM +1.34%), so not chasing an extended gap. Hard 10% stop (63.62) caps a 3x drawdown. Runners-up: SPXL (passed — less momentum, tech-muted index); BMY (passed — +3% on FT report of AstraZeneca merger talks, but a single unconfirmed headline that could reverse on denial, no leverage edge); PLTR (passed — Q2 earnings tonight after close is a binary gap event with NO stop protection, the opposite of the mandate's downside-protection requirement).
positions.risks: 3x leverage magnifies any reversal: if the rotation fades intraday, tech reasserts leadership, oil bounces, or a hot macro print lifts yields, TNA can shed high-single-digit % fast and gap through the 63.62 stop. Small-cap breadth trades are prone to sharp mean-reversion. Mitigant: entry is early in a confirmed leadership move with a real macro tailwind (oil + rates), not an extended chase; hard 10% stop and daily rotation cap the loss. PRICE NOTE: entry 70.69 = dashboard canonical proxy for TNA, asOf 2026-08-03T15:41:18Z (within ~1 min of run time NOW); BTC exit 63812.04 asOf 2026-08-03T15:40:10Z. Non-stale, real.
